question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The politician's speech was an attempt to __mitigate__ the concerns of the citizens.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mitigate"** means to make something less severe, serious, or painful; it refers to the act of reducing the intensity or impact of something. (कम करना, हल्का करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government introduced new policies to mitigate the effects of climate change.
 
 
• **"Lessen"** refers to the act of reducing something in amount, degree, or intensity, which aligns closely with the meaning of "mitigate." (कम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher tried to lessen the students' anxiety before the exam by offering encouragement.
 
 
• Hence, "lessen" is the most appropriate synonym for "mitigate."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aggravate** (बिगाड़ना): To make a problem, injury, or offense worse or more severe.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless remarks only served to aggravate the situation.
 
 
• **Understand** (समझना): To perceive the meaning, significance, or nature of something.
 
 
• **Example:** She took time to understand the concerns of her employees.
 
 
• **Establish** (स्थापित करना): To set up or lay the foundation for something, such as an institution or a belief.
 
 
• **Example:** The organization aims to establish better healthcare facilities in rural areas.
